title: Carl coffee scale
sourceVerification: MascotSkin.appDefault returns carlOfficePreview; skin.json maps mugSip to mug-sip.png and the active restrainedCarlOffice performance uses that pose.
invariants: Square portraits; coffee in both paws; consistent framing and background; CARL name tag fully on lower chest below mug, clear of arms.

images.name: zen
images.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Create ONE square Slack avatar as part of a consistent 9-level Carl coffee-expression scale. The reference is the APPROVED framing template and level 2 expression. Strictly preserve the same Carl character, huge lavender-gray round head, coral inner ears and cheek marks, long charcoal oval nose, eye placement, two paws, plain cream coffee mug, visible dark coffee and subtle steam, torso and arms, muted dark-sage textured background, square canvas and exact crop. Preserve the reference's pixel-edged dark outlines, paper-grain shading, source colors and texture. The small cream name tag reading CARL must stay physically pinned flat entirely on the exposed CENTER lower chest BELOW the mug, with clear gaps from the cup and both arms; never overlay an arm or float in space. Same badge size, coral square and border. Change ONLY facial expression, eye details, eyebrow tension and associated fatigue lines as requested. Keep mug, paws, pose, camera distance and background fixed. No newly introduced clothes, objects, captions, level numbers, borders, watermarks or text other than the CARL name tag. Match the reference image's square dimensions. This image is level 1 of 9. Expression: The calmest endpoint: profound zen-like, almost Buddha-like inner peace expressed ONLY through his face. Eyes softly fully closed in relaxed shallow arcs, eyebrows completely relaxed, a gentle modest contented smile, face smooth and unstrained. He looks awake in peaceful meditation, not sleeping or drugged. No religious costume, halo or added props.
